question: Do the grown counts of fresh in-scope starts (joined rings and rings with a second cycle) equal the cover model's (deck orbits of connected sets of size t + 1 in the universal cover of the candidate complex) at every round grown?

definitions.growth: junctions by round, fewest counts, bare starts

public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py (3 workers, 4G per case, 900 s per case); .venv/bin/python -B merge.py <out dir> <results.json>
public_inputs.reused: JOIN-GROWTH-20261118-001B joinlib.py and fastlib.py (growth); its census runs (gate G1)

forbidden_inputs: Changing the model, a start or the scope after reading any test start
cheapest_meaningful_control: gate G1 (out-of-scope census starts differ), G3 (a mutant model differs), F14 (one-cycle control)

predictions.P1: every fresh in-scope start F01-F17: grown counts = model counts at every round

decision_rules.P1: held iff all 17 equal at every round grown

stop_rule: One run; read-out; referee hand-off; report.
disclosed_exploration: pilot/ (the model found and checked on JOIN-GROWTH's recorded growths: 7 two-ring joins, 36 in-scope census starts)
